_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior porch/veranda ceiling prime+paint (new construction). Context prefix PRCH (PoRCH) — no collision with existing prefixes. Combined prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). Single SF-based paintable item. Overhead work is the defining production characteristic. Key difference from soffit: no vent type constraint (spray always eligible), no vinyl substrate, beadboard panel type added.

paintable_items.name: Exterior porch ceiling field surface
paintable_items.notes: Single paintable item — porch/veranda ceiling surface area (porch width x porch length). SF-based like soffit. Covers all porch ceiling substrate types (wood T&G, beadboard, plywood, fiber cement). No vinyl.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XTRM, SFIT. PRCH is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_PRCH_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_PRCH_WASH_LOW_PRESSURE, TSK_PRCH_SAND_PREP, TSK_PRCH_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL, TSK_PRCH_FINISH_1_SPRAY

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — porch floor drop cloths, furniture cover/removal, light fixture/ceiling fan masking, adjacent fascia/wall masking when finished
Low-pressure wash, sand prep (substrate-specific), seal fiber cement cut edges, spot-prime knots, caulk panel joints, dust cleanup
3 substrate paths: acrylic primer for wood/factory-primed FC, alkali-resistant on bare FC, skip when field-primed. No vinyl path.
First finish coat — brush/roll or spray (both always eligible). Cut-in at fascia, wall, and column junctions.
Intercoat inspection. QT4: light sand between coats, dust removal. QT2: skipped (single coat).
Second finish coat. Same method as first. QT2 skips (single coat).
Final inspection, overhead touch-up at edges and joints
Protection teardown, tool cleaning, furniture restore

paintscope_keys.description: Net paintable porch ceiling area (square feet). Porch width x porch length.
Number of porch sections/elevations in scope
Access type (ground/ladder/scaffold/lift). Height modifier stacks with overhead penalty.
Boolean flag confirming new construction context. Always true for NC specs.
Classification of porch ceiling panel/board construction (solid_panel/tg_board/beadboard). T&G and beadboard have 20% higher labor due to joint complexity.
Porch floor area directly below ceiling work zone requiring drop cloth protection.
Count of porch ceiling-mounted light fixtures to mask (ceiling fans, pendant lights, recessed cans)
Count of porch furniture items requiring cover or removal

quality_tier.notes: QT5 excluded — porch ceiling is a large-area overhead field surface, not fine millwork.

application_method.notes: Both methods ALWAYS eligible — no vent type constraint (unlike soffit). Spray is always an option. spray_backroll NOT valid — overhead back-rolling is impractical.

sheen.notes: Per Exterior_Color_Sheen_Configuration_Doctrine: overhead surfaces use flat or satin. Flat is most common porch ceiling sheen.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for porch ceiling field. EA for protection items, knot spot-prime count, edge seal count. LF for caulk joints. FIXED for equipment setup/cleanup.

substrate_state.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD: bare wood T&G, beadboard, or plywood porch ceiling. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY: fiber cement panels with factory transit primer. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD: any substrate already field-primed. No vinyl substrate.

protection_level.notes: edge_only for porch floor in brush/roll mode. full_cover for porch floor/furniture in spray mode. light_mask for adjacent fascia/wall and fixtures.

typical_relationship.notes: same_finish: soffit (often continuous same color). different_finish: fascia, wall, columns, porch floor.

surface_ids.notes: porch_ceiling is proposed. soffit_field proposed by SF_SOFFIT_EXT_NC. ext_trim_fascia proposed by SF_TRIM_EXT_NC. porch_floor and porch_column are proposed for future specs.

zone_ids.notes: New zone for porch ceiling — house wall at porch attachment

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_ACRYLIC — same acrylic primer concept from soffit

material_system_prefix.notes: 3 substrate-driven primers (acrylic for wood/FC, tannin spot for wood knots, alkali-resistant for bare FC) + 2 QT-driven finish systems. No vinyl bonding primer or solar-reflective finish (no vinyl substrate). Simpler than soffit (5 systems vs 7).

proposed_configurations.description: 1 prime + 2 finish coats — standard NC sequence at QT3/QT4
2 finish coats only — field-primed surface at QT3/QT4
1 finish coat only — economy QT2 on field-primed surface

proposed_profiles.description: Acrylic primer coverage on porch ceiling — 250-350 SF/gal smooth panels. T&G/beadboard rough-sawn: apply 1.15 surface_factor.
Alkali-resistant primer coverage on bare fiber cement porch ceiling — 200-300 SF/gal.
Finish coat coverage on primed porch ceiling — 250-350 SF/gal smooth panels.

deduplication_notes: Fascia and frieze are separate spec scope (SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1). This spec handles porch ceiling side of fascia-ceiling junction.
Soffit is separate scope (SF_SOFFIT_EXT_NC_v1). When porch ceiling is continuous with eave soffit, edge work at transition is minimal (same color typical).
Porch floor painting is NOT this spec's scope — future spec or out of scope entirely.
Porch column painting is NOT this spec's scope — future spec or part of trim scope.
House wall painting at porch attachment is siding spec scope.

proposed_modifiers.description: Overhead work penalty — ALL porch ceiling tasks
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: BAKED_INTO_BASE_RATES — not applied as a stacking modifier
proposed_modifiers.source: Research RF-002: overhead work reduces production rates by 25-35%. Same design as soffit spec.

proposed_modifiers.applies_to: Brush/roll application and wood sand prep tasks. T&G and beadboard both have groove joints requiring brush work.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_PRCH_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_PORCH_CEILING_FIELD MUST be used exactly as listed in this resolution's paintable_items
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums
